channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: “Vamos para a rua”, diz fundador da Petz sobre caso Moraes-Vorcaro
item.description: Sergio Zimerman, founder of Petz, stated that Brazilians should protest in the streets if the revelations involving Minister Alexandre de Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro do not lead to consequences. He criticized the annulment of the PF report and called for action against corruption in the country.

item.title: Como estavam Lula e Bolsonaro nas pesquisas um mês antes da eleição de 2022
item.description: One month before the 2026 election, Lula leads polls with 37-39% and Flávio Bolsonaro trails with 30-33%. In 2022, Lula had 42-45% and Bolsonaro 32-34%. Augusto Cury is now the third candidate, surpassing Ciro Gomes and Simone Tebet from the previous race.

item.title: Política externa ganha centralidade na eleição e desafia próximo presidente
item.description: Foreign policy has become a central issue in the 2026 elections due to geopolitical tensions and U.S. tariffs and sanctions on Brazil. Candidates feature sections in their platforms addressing international proposals, emphasizing relations with major powers and issues such as critical minerals and organized crime. Experts note that the next president will need to balance alliances in a fragmented global scenario.

item.title: Lula registra vitórias, mas é pressionado por crises a um mês do 1º turno
item.description: One month before the first round, Lula leads the polls but faces pressure from STF crises and investigations involving his son, which could harm his re-election bid.

item.title: Confira as agendas dos candidatos à Presidência nesta sexta-feira (4/9)
item.description: Five presidential candidates have public schedules on Friday (9/4), with activities across several states. Lula (PT), Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), Zema (Novo), Caiado (PSD), and Augusto Cury (Avante) are holding rallies, interviews, site visits, and business meetings. Pablo Marçal (PRTB) and Renan Santos (Missão) did not release a schedule or had events suspended.

item.title: Crise no STF e impeachment de Moraes dominam a pauta dos presidenciáveis
item.description: The crisis at the STF involving Minister Alexandre de Moraes and the Vorcaro case has become the central issue in the 2026 presidential race, with most candidates calling for the impeachment of judges as a popularity strategy. Lula seeks distance and focuses on institutional agenda, while Flávio Bolsonaro leads attacks on the judiciary, pushing for Moraes's prosecution.

item.title: Veja a agenda dos candidatos ao governo de SP nesta sexta (4/9)
item.description: São Paulo gubernatorial candidates carry out campaign agendas on Friday. Tarcísio de Freitas and Fernando Haddad lead polls with scheduled events.

item.title: A um mês do 1º turno, Flávio ganha munição com Moraes, mas Dark Horse pesa
item.description: One month from the first round, Flávio Bolsonaro remains Lula's closest rival, technically tied in a potential runoff. The campaign faces challenges with the Dark Horse funding investigation and revelations involving Moraes and Vorcaro. Despite crises, the senator maintains second place in polls.

item.title: Lula desembarca no Ceará para ajudar Elmano na disputa contra Ciro Gomes
item.description: President Lula arrived in Ceará to support Elmano de Freitas in the gubernatorial race against Ciro Gomes, with a walk in Juazeiro do Norte. The agenda aims to reduce the gap between the two candidates, who remain ahead of Elmano by nine points according to Datafolha.

item.title: TSE assina e lacra nesta sexta sistemas das eleições de 2026
item.description: The TSE signs and seals on Friday (4/9) the electronic systems to be used in the 2026 elections, completing the compilation phase of electoral programs started this week. The ceremony, scheduled for 8:30 am in Brasília, includes generating hashes to ensure software integrity, with participation from oversight entities such as PF, OAB, and TCU.

item.title: O contra-ataque de Moraes a Mendonça: a crise inédita na história do Supremo - O Assunto #1798
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes sent a formal request to Court President Edson Fachin to investigate fellow minister André Mendonça for administrative misconduct and abuse of authority in the Master case. The crisis unfolded after Mendonça released wiretap reports revealing communications between Moraes and former Banco Master owner Daniel Vorcaro. Fachin set a five-day deadline for statements from all involved parties.

item.title: Delação relata malas de dinheiro e remessas de Vorcaro
item.description: The plea bargain of Antônio Carlos Freixo Júnior reveals offshore transfers and cash bag deliveries involving Daniel Vorcaro, founder of Banco Master, with suspected ties to Eduardo and Flávio Bolsonaro. Freixo served as financial operator for Vorcaro, while middlemen charged 4% for cash operations, and funds were transferred to Havengate Development Fund, linked to lawyer Paulo Calixto, close to Eduardo Bolsonaro.

item.title: Candidato ao GDF, Expedito Mendonça propõe fim do STF em plano de governo
item.description: Expedito Mendonça, candidate for GDF by PCO, proposes abolishing the STF and electing judges and prosecutors by popular vote. His plan also calls for repealing the Clean Record Act. The 1988 Constitution protects the STF through pétrea clauses.

item.title: Agro, assessores e bilionários: quem doa para Tarcísio e Haddad em SP
item.description: With less than 30 days to the São Paulo elections, Tarcísio and Haddad have nearly R$ 25 million in campaign funds, highlighted by billionaire donations such as the Seibel brothers and Guilherme Mognon. Tarcísio leads in individual contributions, while Haddad relies more on party funding.

item.title: PF afirma que Mendonça considerava PGR “indigno” por relação com Gilmar
item.description: A Federal Police report suggests that Minister André Mendonça deemed Paulo Gonet 'unworthy' to lead investigations due to his closeness to Minister Gilmar Mendes, indicating that Mendonça attempted to politically influence the inquiries into Banco Master and INSS.

item.title: Segurança bloqueia acesso a fachada de vidro do STF após foto de ministros às gargalhadas
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court blocked photographers' access to the building's glass facade after a photo of justices laughing amid the Daniel Vorcaro message leak crisis. The restriction aims to prevent further image releases that could spark controversies involving Justice Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Arruda pode seguir fazendo campanha no DF? Pode recorrer? Entenda o que acontece agora
item.description: The Regional Electoral Court of the Federal District unanimously rejected the candidacy registration of José Roberto Arruda (PSD) for the DF governorship, deeming him ineligible due to convictions related to Operation Pandora's Box. Nevertheless, Arruda is allowed to continue campaigning while his appeal is reviewed by the Superior Electoral Court (TSE), which will make the final decision on his candidacy. The case hinges on interpretations of the 2025 Clean Record Law.

item.title: Crise no STF se agrava e Lula pede investigação transparente
item.description: President Lula requested a transparent investigation by the STF into the Banco Master scandal, involving ministers and public figures. The crisis at the STF worsens with demands for greater clarity in investigations.

item.title: PF diz que Mendonça avaliou afastar diretor-geral por proximidade com Lula
item.description: The Federal Police reported to the Supreme Court that Minister André Mendonça considered removing the corporation's director-general due to closeness with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The report was requested by Minister Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: PF diz que Mendonça desconfiava de Andrei por proximidade com Lula
item.description: PF reports suggest that Justice Minister André Mendonça suspected Federal Police Director Andrei Rodrigues of being too close to President Lula, recommending his removal. Justice Alexandre de Moraes used these documents to request an investigation into Mendonça for abuse of authority and administrative misconduct, accusing him of biased conduct in inquiries. The conflict involves allegations of political interference and controversial stances on PF independence.

item.title: Eleições 2026: O que faz um senador?
item.description: A senator represents a state or the Federal District in the Federal Senate, serving an eight-year term with duties including lawmaking, government oversight, and judging authorities for misconduct. In 2026, two senators will be elected per federative unit, renewing two-thirds of the chamber.

item.title: VÍDEO: entenda por que um deputado eleito pode 'puxar' outro candidato nas eleições
item.description: In Brazil's proportional system, votes for one deputy candidate can help elect others from the same party. The electoral quotient divides votes by available seats, and the highest-voted candidates from the party fill those seats. This explains how one elected candidate can 'pull' other party members.

item.title: Taxa das blusinhas: falta de coerência atrapalhou debate, diz varejo
item.description: The federal government approved the end of the 'taxa das blusinhas', enabling partial exemption from import duties for international purchases. The IDV questions the coherence of the measure, alleging violation of tax equity and advocates legal actions for suspension of the rule. The retail sector warns that the tax burden gap between domestic and imported products has worsened, negatively impacting the competitiveness of the Brazilian industry.

item.title: Renan Santos diz que Cury é sócio de empresa que tentou comprar Master
item.description: Renan Santos (Missão) accuses Augusto Cury (Avante) of being a partner in a company that attempted to buy Banco Master, linking him to influencers investigated in the Master Case. The accusation involves an R$31.5 million SCP and Fictor Invest's failed billion-dollar acquisition, leading to the bank's liquidation and creditor crisis.

item.title: 'Ninguém deve ser poupado', diz Augusto Cury sobre Supremo e perda de confiança nas instituições
item.description: Augusto Cury criticized polarization in the Supreme Court and stated that no one should be exempt from investigations, reinforcing the need for transparency and justice for all, even if it involves justices. He lamented the loss of trust in institutions and warned against the country's division affecting families and political debate.

item.title: Relatório da PF avalia Alcolumbre como “provável alvo estratégico”
item.description: A Federal Police report suggests Davi Alcolumbre is a likely strategic target in the Master case investigation, with suspicions that Minister Andrey Mendonça acted to expand his influence within the STF. The Senate President was identified as resistant to Mendonça's appointment during Bolsonaro's administration, while Alcolumbre has publicly defended Alexandre de Moraes following controversies involving leaked conversations.

item.title: Judiciário perdeu a capacidade de se envergonhar, diz Samer Agi
item.description: Former judge Samer Agi labeled the Banco Master case as the biggest corruption scandal in Brazilian judicial history and called for Justice Alexandre de Moraes' removal. He warned the scandal harms the Supreme Court's reputation and may influence the 2026 presidential race, where Flávio Bolsonaro leads Lula in a second-round scenario. Agi emphasized equal treatment between judges and justices to uphold the Democratic State of Law.

item.title: Crise no STF: veja a repercussão política após Moraes pedir a Fachin investigação contra Mendonça
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes requested measures against fellow minister André Mendonça over the Banco Master case, accusing him of administrative misconduct. The move sparked polarized reactions: opposition lawmakers criticized Moraes, while government allies focused on scrutinizing Banco Master’s ties to Bolsonaro-aligned figures.

item.title: PF sugere haver “assimetria” em decisões de André Mendonça
item.description: PF reports suggest Justice Minister André Mendonça has taken an asymmetrical stance in judicial decisions involving politicians from different ideological backgrounds, favoring right-wing figures and delaying rulings against left-leaning officials. Minister Alexandre de Moraes has requested an investigation into Mendonça for alleged abuse of authority and administrative misconduct.

item.title: Instituto do qual Mendonça se afastou recebeu R$ 11,5 milhões de órgãos públicos sem licitação
item.description: The private institute founded by Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça signed 68 non-bid contracts with public agencies in 15 states since 2024, receiving R$11.5 million. The contracts were identified by the Ministry of Management and Innovation in Public Services, a finding that may raise concerns about transparency and public resource usage.

item.title: Campanha de Lula busca ponte com Cury e tenta evitar que ele se alie a Flávio
item.description: Lula's campaign seeks to forge a connection with Augusto Cury (Avante) to prevent him from supporting Flávio Bolsonaro in a potential runoff. The strategy aims to neutralize rival alliances in the 2026 election race.

item.title: Marina Silva defende que Moraes se afaste do STF e critica Mendonça
item.description: Marina Silva stated that the revelations involving Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro are very serious and advocated for his temporary removal from the STF. She also criticized Mendonça for misconduct in the investigations. The messages indicate a close relationship between Moraes and Vorcaro, including million-dollar contracts between Banco Master and Viviane Barci's office.

item.title: Moraes usou relatório interno da PF ‘sem valor probatório’ para acusar Mendonça de interferências
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes used an internal Federal Police report—de low probative value—to accuse fellow minister André Mendonça of undue interference in investigations. The unofficial document, based on anonymous testimonies, challenges Mendonça’s conduct in cases related to INSS and Vorcaro, yet contradicts some claims made by Moraes. The conflict involves mutual accusations of power abuse and jurisdictional overreach.

item.title: Pedido de Moraes abre margem para anular inquéritos contra Vorcaro e Lulinha
item.description: Minister Alexandre de Moraes filed a motion at the Supreme Federal Court that may result in the annulment of investigations against Daniel Vorcaro and Fábio Luís Lula da Silva. The decision opens the door for judicial reviews in cases connected to Compliance Zero. The case involves central figures in Brazilian politics and finance.

item.title: De PCO a Bolsonaro: saiba quem é alvo do inquérito das fake news, usado por Moraes contra Mendonça
item.description: The fake news inquiry, opened by Dias Toffoli and handled by Alexandre de Moraes, was expanded to include investigations against Supreme Court minister André Mendonça and other critics of the STF, such as YouTuber Allan do Santos and former activist Sara Winter. Moraes acts as investigator, victim, and judge simultaneously, increasing the risk of abuses in the process, as denounced by human rights organizations.

item.title: Copa do Brasil: Gre-Nal termina com provocação e briga no túnel de acesso
item.description: In the Copa do Brasil, Grêmio defeated Internacional 3-1 to reach the semifinals, but the match was marked by provocations and a tunnel brawl between the coaching staffs. The arena played a waltz referencing Internacional's 15 years without titles, while coach Paulo Pezzolano got into a fight. The next clash will be against Atlético-MG, replaying the 2016 final.

item.title: TRE indefere candidatura de José Roberto Arruda ao governo do DF
item.description: The Federal District Electoral Court decided to reject José Roberto Arruda's candidacy for governor due to his conviction for administrative misconduct under the Clean Record Act. Despite the ruling, Arruda stated he will appeal to the Supreme Electoral Court and continue his electoral campaign.

item.title: “O criminoso é Moraes”, diz Malafaia ao defender André Mendonça
item.description: Pastor Silas Malafaia defended Supreme Court minister André Mendonça and accused Alexandre de Moraes of attempting to invert roles by pointing to 'strong evidence' of crimes. Malafaia claimed Mendonça merely removed secrecy and forwarded the case to the plenary without accusing Moraes, stating that 'the criminal is Alexandre de Moraes and not André Mendonça'.

item.title: ‘Pacto de 1988 acabou’: Renan Santos defende nova Constituição ao tratar da crise no Judiciário
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate from Missão, advocates for a new Constitution starting in 2027, strongly criticizing the Supreme Federal Court and accusing Minister Alexandre de Moraes of acting arbitrarily. He also attacked other candidates such as Augusto Cury and addressed issues like public security, education, and fiscal responsibility, taking conservative stances on affirmative action and school content control. During a CNN interview, he reinforced polarizing speeches, portraying himself as a defender of institutions and traditional family values.

item.title: Renan Santos defende discutir nova Constituição como resposta à crise no STF
item.description: Renan Santos advocates for discussing a new Constitution to address the crisis at the STF, criticizing ministers Alexandre de Moraes and André Mendonça. He questions the legality of Moraes-led investigations and claims the next president should not recognize decisions from these justices. The context involves the Moraes-Vorcaro case and the suspension of the candidate's digital campaign by TSE.

item.title: Mendonça citou ‘proximidade’ de Gonet com Gilmar Mendes para defender afastamento do PGR, diz PF
item.description: Minister André Mendonça reportedly questioned the reliability of Attorney General Paulo Gonet due to his alleged close ties with Minister Gilmar Mendes, according to a Federal Police report. The document also criticizes Andrei Passos Rodrigues for his alleged connection to President Lula. These statements supported Alexandre de Moraes' decision.

item.title: Datafolha: Campanha zera efeito 'Dark Horse' e Cury finca bandeira no eleitor de centro
item.description: A new Datafolha poll shows the 'Dark Horse' effect surrounding Flávio Bolsonaro is fading, with the gap between Lula and the senator returning to pre-scandal levels, indicating a tight electoral race.

item.title: Clima de guerra no STF tem até suspeita de investigação clandestina da PF contra Mendonça
item.description: Suspicions of a covert PF investigation into Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça have unsettled the STF, with claims that the police produced intelligence materials to discredit him. The controversy involves figures like Alexandre de Moraes, Edson Fachin, and Lula, raising concerns over institutional interference and message leaks.

item.title: Alexandre de Moraes acusa André Mendonça de violações que ele mesmo cometeu
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes added colleague André Mendonça to the fake news investigation, accusing him of meddling in probes, but Moraes himself has faced similar criticism for his conduct, particularly regarding the suo moto probe and interactions with TSE staff. The internal conflict within the Supreme Court reflects a broader institutional crisis in Brazil.

item.title: Lula se posiciona sobre crise no STF e defende reforma do sistema Judiciário
item.description: President Lula expressed his position on the STF crisis for the first time, advocating for reforms in the political and judicial systems and calling for investigations 'regardless of who is involved'. He highlighted the Banco Master case as 'the biggest theft in Brazil's history' and criticized selective leaks.

item.title: PF diz que Mendonça determinou ações 'sem autorização específica' contra Moraes; decisões causaram crise no tribunal
item.description: The Federal Police alleges that Minister André Mendonça ordered investigations against Minister Alexandre de Moraes without specific authorization, causing a crisis at the STF. The report indicates that Mendonça requested targeted investigations involving Moraes and other STF members, suggesting differential treatment among authorities. These actions were interpreted as an internal conflict now exposed within the court.

item.title: Como os líderes do PCC e CV, Vorcaro mantém o poder mesmo preso e investe na crise institucional
item.description: Daniel Vorcaro, a former banker jailed at Papudinha, continues to wield influence over Brazilian institutions, fueling splits within the STF and PF while orchestrating institutional wear-and-tear and polarization, with links to figures like Flávio Bolsonaro and allies of Lula.

item.title: Sem discurso novo e com avaliação pior, Lula vê Flávio na cola na eleição da sujeira judicial
item.description: Lula's candidacy faces challenges with declining government approval and a technical tie with Flávio Bolsonaro in the second round, within a political scenario marked by the judicial-political war involving figures from the Supreme Court.

item.title: Leia a íntegra do pedido de investigação de Moraes contra Mendonça
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes sent a request for investigation against fellow Justice André Mendonça to STF President Alexandre Edson Fachin, citing evidence of administrative misconduct, abuse of authority, and political favoritism in the Sem Desconto and Compliance Zero cases. The conflict escalated after Mendonça released a Federal Police report containing messages between Moraes and former Banco Master CEO Daniel Vorcaro. Fachin ordered all involved parties to submit written statements within five days.

item.title: Fachin manda Mendonça, Moraes, Gonet e chefe da PF prestarem informações sobre diálogos com Vorcaro
item.description: The president of the STF, Luiz Edson Fachin, ordered ministers André Mendonça and Alexandre de Moraes, the Attorney General Paulo Gonet, and the Federal Police director Andrei Rodrigues to provide information about communications with Daniel Vorcaro within five days. The measure investigates a Federal Police report that points Moraes as an interlocutor in messages from Vorcaro. The case involves suspicions of undue influence in power.
